purpose: Re-review exactly nineteen existing vulnerability/package execution-path cases after seven application source changes; this does not fix upstream vulnerable libraries or waive a finding.

changed_sources.review: Pass the already validated trip-day count into the bounded count parser and change generation policy key; candidate grouping remains typed POI operations with no native loader or process boundary.
Pass travel_days into quantity extraction in normal/revision prompts. Existing model and fixed route/RAG calls are unchanged; no arbitrary symbol, file import or command execution is introduced.
Extend bounded Python re patterns to single-day explicit quantity wording and adjectives. User text remains matched data, not regex source; the Python re engine is not libc POSIX regcomp/regexec.

Invalidate old generated candidate/draft checkpoints after the quantity-prompt policy change, retaining only unchanged raw provider facts. JSON comparisons and fixed business HTTP checkpoint calls, not database paths, raw SQL or dynamic loading.
Supply travel_days to the same daily quantity parser while validating final counts. No native API, loader, subprocess, sqlite import or journal path is added.

Preserve source-line boundaries, truncate whole units and instruct per-sentence quotes. Regex patterns remain application constants and the model is the existing bounded HTTP client; no native or shell dispatch.

Strip only Markdown markers followed by whitespace consistently from original and response sentences; retain signed amounts, decimals, negation and full sentence equality. Uses Python re, not libc POSIX regex.

image_layer_identity.overlay_scope: Seven reviewed app modules and offline provider fixture; seven pure-Python OpenTelemetry wheels; lock/config/labels. No native binaries added by these overlays.
